description: This file defines the interface for RTL8367C switch port trunking features, including function declarations for setting and getting trunking groups, flood settings, hash selection, trunking mode, flow control, and hash table configurations. It includes macro definitions and external method declarations specific to the RTL8367C switch ASIC.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingGroup
methods.description: Sets the trunking group configuration with specified group ID and port mask.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the port mask for a specified trunking group ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingFlood
methods.description: Enables or disables flooding for trunking.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingFlood
methods.description: Checks if flooding for trunking is enabled.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingHashSelect
methods.description: Selects the hash algorithm used for trunking.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingHashSelect
methods.description: Retrieves the current hash algorithm selection.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicQeueuEmptyStatus
methods.description: Checks the queue status of ports, indicating if queues are empty.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingMode
methods.description: Sets the trunking mode of the switch.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingMode
methods.description: Gets the current trunking mode configuration.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingFc
methods.description: Enables or disables flow control for a specific trunking group.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingFc
methods.description: Retrieves whether flow control is enabled for a trunking group.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingHashTable
methods.description: Maps a hash value to a specific port ID in the trunking hash table.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingHashTable
methods.description: Retrieves the port ID associated with a hash value in the hash table.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingHashTable1
methods.description: Alternative or additional hash table mapping to port ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingHashTable1
methods.description: Retrieves port ID from the alternative hash table mapping.
